summary: Lower general JavaScript multiplication through a semantics helper when coercion or BigInt is possible.

target.notes: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds.

semantics.evaluation_order: left expression, right expression, then required coercions in specification order
semantics.coercion: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds.

caveats: Object coercion may invoke user-defined valueOf/toString/Symbol.toPrimitive with side effects or exceptions.
Symbol operands can make numeric/string coercion throw TypeError.

tests.name: edge multiplication numeric-kind behavior
tests.expected_behavior: prints TypeError because BigInt and Number cannot be mixed
